title: Cheapest flight per origin
statementMd:
For each origin airport show the cheapest flight (id and base price).

Expected columns: `origin`, `id`, `base_price`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Compare with the minimum price of the same origin.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT f.origin, f.id, f.base_price FROM flights f WHERE f.base_price = (SELECT MIN(f2.base_price) FROM flights f2 WHERE f2.origin = f.origin);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
